studies.title: Real Data Project / R-Dub longitudinal natural-products data exchange
studies.objective: Collect, analyze, and share real-world evidence from people using cannabis and other natural products in everyday life.
studies.population_or_specimen: community participants using cannabis or other natural products
studies.observation_schedule: QuickLog repeated experiences over time; individual study schedules vary.
studies.data_availability: Public dashboards and highlighted findings; participant-level data not copied.
limitations: Project-level methodology; individual outcome claims require study-specific sources.

studies.title: MoreBetter Functional Beverage Study
studies.objective: Characterize real-world infused-cannabis-beverage use, effects, preferences, dose, and co-use patterns.
studies.observation_schedule: 22-day study period reported on the public study page.
exposures_or_interventions: self-selected infused cannabis beverage products and doses
studies.data_availability: Public free report via controlled link; deeper reports are paid/controlled access; raw participant-level data not ingested.
limitations: Public webpage summarizes aggregate results rather than exposing the raw dataset.

studies.title: Science of Smokability Phase I — water activity
studies.objective: Evaluate how cannabis flower water activity influences chemistry and perceived smoking quality.
studies.population_or_specimen: cannabis flower conditioned at multiple water activities and sensory evaluators
studies.data_availability: Published results article and project page; no participant-level data ingested.
limitations: Publication is not a clinical efficacy trial.

studies.title: Science of Smokability Phase II — nutrients and flushing
studies.objective: Study relationships among cultivation nutrient/flushing practices, flower characteristics, post-harvest handling, and smokability.
exposures_or_interventions: nutrient and flushing treatments described by the project
outcomes: planned chemical, physical, and sensory measures
studies.data_availability: Project/waitlist page only in this seed registry.
limitations: No outcome claims are admitted until a results source is verified.

studies.title: CHS symptoms and cannabis use patterns survey
organizations: UCI Center for the Study of Cannabis
studies.objective: Examine cannabis-use patterns and symptom profiles among people suspected or diagnosed with CHS.
exposures_or_interventions: self-reported cannabis use history and consumption patterns
studies.data_availability: Published aggregate results; participant-level data not ingested.
limitations: Associations are not proof of causation.

studies.title: Kratom real-world repeated-measures methodology study
studies.objective: Evaluate dose-dependent self-reported focus and energy outcomes using a baseline plus repeated daily real-world observational design.
studies.observation_schedule: 7-day baseline followed by 14 days of daily observational reporting.
studies.ethics: Electronic informed consent reported by the publication.
studies.data_availability: Open-access CC BY publication; raw participant-level records are not ingested.
limitations: Full dataset had varying completion; analyses used smaller completion subsets.
Observational self-report limits causal inference and generalizability.

studies.title: Botanical LC-MS/MS molecular networking and authentication workflow
studies.objective: Apply LC-MS/MS molecular networking to profile botanical chemical space, annotate metabolites, and compare supplements with plant specimens.
studies.data_availability: Article reports raw analysis files in MassIVE accession MSV000088444 and supplementary molecular-network/MS/MS material.
limitations: Spectral-library annotations can be putative and require orthogonal confirmation for definitive identity.

studies.title: PRISM botanical library workflow
studies.objective: Build and use a botanical natural-product library that connects specimen provenance, extraction/fractionation, screening, and follow-up isolation.
studies.data_availability: Workflow described in the educational paper; a later open-access ACS Omega study demonstrates screening use.
limitations: General natural-product workflow, not cannabis-specific evidence.
